scenes.head: Register for VAT only after sales pass AED 375,000?
scenes.say: Myth or fact? You only register for VAT once your sales have already passed three hundred and seventy-five thousand dirhams.

scenes.desc: mandatory VAT registration threshold, on taxable supplies and imports
scenes.src: Source: Federal Tax Authority, Mandatory Registration, tax.gov.ae; checked 29 Oct 2026. The threshold does not apply to foreign businesses. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: Myth. The threshold is three hundred and seventy-five thousand dirhams of taxable supplies and imports, and the Federal Tax Authority applies two tests.
Look back over the past twelve months. And look ahead: if you expect taxable supplies and imports to exceed it in the next thirty days, you must register too.

scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Valorin is an independent advisory firm, not affiliated with the FTA or MoF.
scenes.say: So check both tests every month, and again when you sign a large contract. Questions? Talk to us on WhatsApp. General information only, not legal or tax advice.
